actor_report:
Observations: schema/orders.schema.json is now version 2 and requires [id, amount, currency]. VALIDATION.md V1 still records a pass against version 1. data/orders.json has no 'currency' on either item. The customers schema is still version 1, and data/customers.json meets it.

Work: I kept V1's original result and marked it stale and superseded instead of overwriting it, because a result on a different basis does not overwrite an earlier one and a stale basis does not count as current (FOUNDATIONS Result algebra; RF-005). I added V3 as the current evaluation of orders against version 2, which fails. I re-checked V2 against the current basis, and it still passes. I set the Gate line to blocked because the checklist's own rule (every record must be a current pass) is falsified by V3 and by the stale V1.

I made no edits to data/ or schema/. Those edits were prohibited, and choosing whether to add currency to the data or change the schema belongs to the data/schema owner (SPEC_METHOD Computed Classification: candidate behavior cannot author its own target law; RF-006 authority conservation).

Unresolved:
(1) Release stays blocked until the data/schema owner adds currency to the order items or changes the schema. Then V3 must be re-evaluated.
(2) V2 and V3 were judged by manual inspection, not by a JSON Schema validator. No commands were run.
(3) I proposed the file edits but did not observe them being applied. Application by the host is outside my observation boundary.
(4) The checklist does not define the allowed Gate values, so I chose 'blocked' with a reason as the plain non-pass value.
